comments.author: Bionjohan
comments.body_html:
In case you want to use this mod for the newest SPT-versions and don’t know how to, follow these steps:

1. Download the mod like usual and put the “user” folder from the mod in you SPT folder.

2. Enter the “> user” folder in you SPT folder.

3. Then “> mods”.

4. “> gunsmith”.

5. and lastly “> package.json”

6. open “package.json” with notepad.

7. Then change the “sptVersion”: “~3.11.2” to the current version you are playing. (In my case its version ~3.11.2).

8. To see your current version start the sever and it will print your version in the cmd window. (the cmd window will also be named the current version in my case)

Hope this helps! : )
